_comment: Per-library catalogue links, keyed by the registry's library code.
url:   the record URL, with {id} where the record identifier goes.
rules: ordered. Each pattern is matched against the whole indexed system number and must
capture the record number in group 1; the prefix is put in front of it verbatim, so it
carries its own separator. First match wins; nothing matching means no link at all,
because a wrong catalogue link looks to a reader like a record we found.
Only MZK is here because MZK is the only mapping anyone has verified. Add or override a
library's mapping in its catalogue block in IIIF_LIBRARIES_FILE, rather than editing this
file, which a release will overwrite.
The nine-digit anchor is deliberate and not incidental: an Aleph base ends in digits, so a
greedy trailing-digit match reads mzk03000706629 as prefix mzk + 03000706629 and 404s. Nine
digits is MZK's convention, which is exactly why it lives in configuration and not in code.
